headline: Rescue records confirm Bangka slow loris is still alive
meta_description: Rescue records have confirmed that the Bangka slow loris, an endangered species, remains alive, offering hope for conservation efforts.
summary_short: Rescue records have confirmed the survival of the Bangka slow loris, an endangered primate species, in what conservationists see as encouraging news.
body:
Rescue records have confirmed that the Bangka slow loris is still alive. The discovery provides a measure of hope for efforts to protect this critically endangered primate species.

The Bangka slow loris, found on Indonesia's Bangka Island, is one of the world's most threatened animals. Documentation through rescue operations has now verified the species' continued survival in the wild, giving conservationists concrete evidence to build on as they work to safeguard the remaining population.

The confirmation comes as a reminder that persistence in wildlife protection can yield real results—even for species facing extraordinary odds.
